ownership: M01 wizard authoritative owner. Child returns proof, never installs or selects project independently.
mutation: Only one checked marker Quarantined→Ready; child bytes and catalog prepared at final paths first.
transaction: Exclusive final target create; durable quarantine before public children; all child proofs verified; CAS exact quarantine digest to exact Ready bytes; verify IO receipt then open/bind only with current owner. Unknown commit retained; no retry.
protocol_boundary: COPY-READY-CANDIDATE-v1 is NOT admitted SGA-TRANSITION-v2. Role publish exists but its closed body cannot silently accept these fields. Full candidate hash is actual entire validated candidate object, not old projected shorthand. Exact publish body/schema extension and native shapes require Owner adoption.
